title: UN warns Russian attacks and winter hardship could displace more Ukrainians
summary_full: As winter approaches, Ukraine faces dire challenges with essential services declining due to ongoing conflict. Millions of internally displaced individuals struggle to reunite with their homes, often in ruins. With falling temperatures, access to heating, electricity, and safe drinking water becomes precarious. Funding shortages jeopardize relief initiatives, leaving countless families at risk. Humanitarian organizations are ramping up efforts to offer vital support to affected communities.
